name: Showroom Star Explorer
author: Slim Cognito
description: Blargian Red is free and first among the paints at Slim Cognito's Ship Shack, a new free paint, Showroom Silver, sits right after it, and a new game starts with the showroom Star Explorer: Split Nose, Hi-Lift Wings, Triple Boost Acceleration Engine, Fusion Laser Cannons, Multi-Torpedo Launcher, Mega-Mine Launcher and Showroom Silver.
